definitions.ask: Should a waiting save give up on its own after 10 minutes of lock contention?
definitions.why: Mac highlights scans run up to ~5 min; a bound stops endless bob spawns on a hung lock

choices.label: The wait ends after 10 minutes with the preview kept, and Enter starts a fresh wait
The save keeps retrying until it lands, Esc stops it, or the card closes

definitions.ask: Should the implementer file a large follow-up task bead to shorten how long writing highlights scans hold bob_sync.lock?
definitions.why: The scan holds the lock 80-300 s every 15 min with no writes, breaking every 3 s writer

choices.label: One large task bead records the Mac cron evidence; this plan still changes no bob-cli code
No bead; only album and bank saves learn to wait
